name: Han 2026 Sim2Real-PK Daratumumab Public TMDD ODE
description: Source-limited runtime reconstruction of the public daratumumab two-compartment TMDD ODE generator used to pretrain Sim2Real-PK. Exact source constants and reported performance endpoints are replayed through the API; clinical fine-tuned neural results remain source-limited because YODA IPD and trained checkpoints are unavailable.

validation_run_nonce.name: Cache-busting parameter for exact API replay.

body_weight_kg.name: Reference body weight used in the public daratumumab generator.

albumin_g_l.name: Reference albumin used in the public daratumumab generator.

tpmm_indicator.name: Type-of-multiple-myeloma covariate; 1 increases CL by theta_tpmm_on_cl.

male_indicator.name: Sex covariate; public code uses sex=0 for female, sex=1 for male.

theta_cl_l_h.name: Baseline nonspecific clearance; source code labels this L/h but integrates over days.

theta_q_l_h.name: Intercompartmental clearance; source code labels this L/h but integrates over days.

theta_vm0_mg_h.name: Initial target-mediated Vmax; source code labels this mg/h but integrates over days.

theta_tpmm_on_cl.name: TPMM multiplier on clearance as 1 + theta when TPMM=1.

theta_female_on_v1.name: Female central-volume multiplier as 1 + theta when sex=0.

weight_reference_kg.name: Reference body weight for covariate scaling.

paper_daratumumab_f20_baseline_pct.name: PopPK baseline F20 for daratumumab clinical validation.

paper_ibrutinib_f50_baseline_pct.name: PopPK baseline F50 for ibrutinib comparator.
paper_ibrutinib_f50_baseline_pct.category: Abstract and main text Fig. 3A/B results

paper_ibrutinib_f50_finetuned_pct.name: Finetuned Sim2Real-PK F50 for ibrutinib comparator.
paper_ibrutinib_f50_finetuned_pct.category: Abstract and main text Fig. 3A/B results

paper_trough_target_mg_l.name: Minimum trough target for 99% target saturation.

paper_peak_safety_mg_l.name: Maximum peak safety threshold from highest exposure quartile boundary.
